_comment: Job settings for inference endpoints the examples build from the catalog. Empty by default. Skipped with job_config=. With job_id=, the merged job is not submitted, but generate and evaluate still read the model (for its renderer) from it, and evaluate also reads the sampling max_seq_len (to check prompt length), so keep them matching the attached endpoint. See recipes/README.md, "How an example builds its job", for how this file is merged.
